## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...` and `golangci-lint run` pass locally
- [ ] New/changed behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] `README.md` / `skill/SKILL.md` / `DESIGN.md` updated if commands or agent rules changed
- [ ] No tokens, secrets or real SonarQube data in code, tests or fixtures
- [ ] New GitHub Actions are pinned to a full commit SHA
